scope: Native bridge layout zoom for presenter, audience and preview frames
limitations: Transient blur was not reliably reproduced in automated captures; improvement needs confirmation in the reporting environment.
macOS, Windows and physical external displays not tested.
Published remote decks require rebuilding their bridge; local decks require restarting the updated Slive binary.
reproduceRendering: After building the offline module graph fixture and Slive UI, run node packages/slidock/scripts/verify-native-rendering.mjs from the repository root (Playwright WebKit and Chromium required).
